caption: The same 1,000 privileged operations under each scheme: full virtualization traps all of them and ends at 2,000 μs; para-virtualization turns 800 into 1 μs hypercalls and traps only the other 200, ending at 1,200 μs. The last bar is the 800 μs saved, which is 40% of the full-virtualization time.

spec.aria: Two timelines of 2,000 microseconds: full virtualization spends all 2,000 on 1,000 traps at 2 microseconds each, while para-virtualization spends 800 on hypercalls plus 400 on the remaining 200 traps, finishing 800 microseconds earlier.
